### New venues (including new workshops)

- [ ] Obtain Anthology confirmation of each new venue's identifier and provide its general name and website, without a year or meeting number in the identifier/name ([new venue instructions](https://aclanthology.org/info/contrib/#new-venues)). <!-- task:approve-venue context:submission -->
- [ ] Confirm each new venue meets the Anthology's scope, peer-review, and copyright/licensing conditions ([eligibility](https://aclanthology.org/info/contrib/#about-venues)). <!-- task:venue-eligibility context:submission -->
